label: The inflation rule
subgoals: Look up the congestion ratio of the cell's bin
Leave cells in uncongested bins unchanged
Multiply the area by the capped power of the ratio

label: Total area after inflation
subgoals: Sum the inflated areas of all cells
Scale the factors down when the whitespace budget is exceeded

label: When inflation helps and when it does not
section: When inflation helps and when it does not
subgoals: Use inflation for local cell-density hot spots
Recognise through-net and macro pin-access congestion that inflation cannot fix
Validate inflation settings with a real global route
